description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Necromancy until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Necromancy triggers, causing you to sacrifice Abdel Adrian.
Necromancy returns to the battlefield, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Repeat from step 2.
